from pathlib import Path

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marks = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != background}
    if len(marks) != 1:
        return out
    mark = next(iter(marks))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == mark and row[c + 1] == mark:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
